ctx.x: : Where is that, in L.A. or --

In L.A., right in Chinatown, Club Brazil, right by Chinatown, right in Chinatown, Club Brazil. They're the talk of the town. Every night, nothing but a celebrity, (inaudible) Bing Crosby, Carmen Miranda, all the big, every (inaudible) Bing Crosby (inaudible). I got pictures of all of that. It was a big thing, Machido, Machido, Machido, Machido (inaudible).

Then back in New York again, and I go to the Concord Hotel, the swanky summer resort. We go there. They call the man to -- you don't take those niggers over there. The people smoke marijuana and all that, you know, and they got them living on the premises and all that. So Mr. ______, he say, I don't care what you people say. I've got to see it for myself.
